newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Foreign funds pressure Swedish crown with selling.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds pressure Swedish crown with selling.

text.p: The Swedish crown weakened sharply on Friday, pressured by foreign funds selling the currency, dealers told Reuters.
"It's solely foreigners who are selling. Swedish export companies are probably just enjoying the show," one dealer said.
Dealers, who could not immediately point to specific reasons for the selloff, said important technical resistance levels were broken.
"First we went through 4.5250 against the mark and now we are looking at 4.5450 despite the strength of the dollar. It's a bit worrying but I think it's exaggerated," a dealer said.
By 1015 GMT the crown had softened to 4.5510 against the German mark compared to 4.5015 late Thursday. At the same time the dollar firmed to 7.7540 crowns from 7.6341.
